hook: Your whole Board shares one water level: pick three towering walls or seven attackers, and drown whatever sits Under.
loop: Pour Health into the shared Pool and choose how many Board seats
The Pool splits into your Level, every Board unit's Health
High water drowns Under units; Attack buffs make each unit hit

growth.line: Pool grows linearly each End of Turn; Miller and Kobus multiply Pours up to x4 from Tier 4-5.

feel.early: Thin; each new coot dilutes the Level
feel.mid: Seat-or-levy votes on every buy and sell
feel.late: Huge Pools; the Peilmeester drowns wide boards

stars.why: Drowns Under units on both boards, your own outsiders too
Other tribes pay the levy, so every slot is a choice
Turns water into Attack; lowering the Level becomes a play

card_short.u01: Gains Attack for each other Board unit
card_short.u03: When played: Pour for each Board unit
card_short.u04: Start of Combat: gains a third of your Level as Attack
card_short.u05: Selling a Board unit pays gold, more at high Level
card_short.u06: Seats one of your other-tribe units on the Board
card_short.u07: End of Turn: summons a Coot Chick
card_short.u08: End of Turn: Board units gain Attack, more if below Level
card_short.u09: Hunts Under enemies and hits them for double damage
card_short.u10: End of Turn: Pour per Board unit, give them Attack
card_short.u11: Your other Pour effects pour twice as much
card_short.u12: End of Turn: trade Pool water for Attack across the Board
card_short.u13: Start of Turn: trade 5 Pool water for 2 gold
card_short.u14: End of Turn: Pour 5 per non-Board unit you have
card_short.u15: When a Board unit dies, share Level among the rest
card_short.u16: Board units' End of Turn effects happen twice
card_short.u17: Damage to one Board unit is split across the Board
card_short.u18: Start of Combat: Under units on both boards drown
card_short.u19: Start of Combat: raises your Level by half this fight

builds.name: High Water
builds.line: Two or three Board units, outsiders pay the levy, Level soars

builds.name: Full Benches
builds.line: Six or seven Board units; count cards, Aaltje and the Pup finish

builds.name: Seats for Hire
builds.line: Heemraad seats Oozes, Birds or Bog units; their Health becomes everyone's

liked: Every buy and sell is a vote: more seats or higher water
Shared Health and Under drowning your own outsiders play unlike any tribe
worries: Levy-Master with the Miller and Kobus pours about 80 a turn: the high roll
Peilmeester (with Hendrika) wipes wide boards; Spaarndam Pup swings hero damage
changed: A Board unit's own Health is its printed Health, closing the Fly South loop
The Peilmeester now drowns every Under unit, as the tribe promises
Winter Raft and Ledger Coot now read the water Level
verdict: Cross-tribe puzzlers chasing big highs get one shared water level that makes every buy a vote.
